name: Olea
source:
Interest: Nature & Camping

This is the first time I have made a faceless, gender-neutral character. In spite of this, Olea is not a blank state protagonist. The discrepancy between the monologue and speech was done on purpose, as a hint to Olea's true nature.

[From in-game character profiles description]

Olea is actually a human reincarnation of the olive tree deity that resides in the forest near Calcari Village.
